blocks.x: My name is Monk Rowe and we’re in Manhattan at the International Association of Jazz Educators conference. I’m pleased to have Joe Muranyi with me this afternoon. Did I pronounce your name good?
In Hungary they do it different, is that right?
In Hungary, I wouldn’t say it’s a common name but everybody pronounces it correctly: mu-ray-nee is how they say it.
